status: STARTING SET - approved by Shibi Oct 22 2026 (OQ-42, OQ-47)
_note: Starting set (was the T1 draft); stays data-driven, names, triggers and numbers remain tunable except denarii_per_medal (DESIGN.md). Mirrors docs/design/medals.md. Not yet wired into gameplay, UI or the economy.
_denarii_per_medal_source: DESIGN.md: 10/medal. No other medal rewards. Single source of truth vs economy.json: OQ-49.

trigger_types.kill: One kill by you that meets every `require` flag.
trigger_types.multikill: `kills` kills in one life, each within `window_s` seconds of the previous one.
trigger_types.spree: `kills` kills in one life without dying.
trigger_types.consecutive_kills: Your last `count` kills in one life all meet every `require` flag.
trigger_types.kill_count_in_match: `count` kills in one match that meet every `require` flag. Awarded once per match.
trigger_types.scorestreak_earned: You earn the scorestreak `streak_id` (thresholds live in scorestreaks.json, not here).
trigger_types.hill_hold: You stay inside the hill for `continuous_s` seconds in a row while your squad scores (uncontested). Once per continuous hold.
trigger_types.squad_hill_hold: At least `min_members_inside` living members of your squad (you included) are inside the hill together for `continuous_s` seconds in a row while your squad scores. Once per continuous hold.
trigger_types.squad_bot_chain: Your squad bots make `count` kills in one Denarii chain (the chain resets on bot death, as in the economy rules).
trigger_types.first_kill_of_match: The first kill of the match by anyone.

kill_flags.headshot: The killing hit was a headshot.
kill_flags.assassination: Melee kill from behind (DESIGN.md instant kill).
kill_flags.victim_on_hill: The victim was inside the hill.
kill_flags.hill_contested_before: Before the kill, more than one squad was inside the hill.
kill_flags.only_killer_squad_on_hill_after: After the kill, only your squad is inside the hill.
kill_flags.victim_is_kill_leader: The victim had the most personal kills in the match (ties count) and at least 1 kill.
kill_flags.min_distance_m: You were at least this many meters from the victim.
kill_flags.victim_damaged_squadmate_within_s: The victim damaged a living squadmate of yours within this many seconds.
kill_flags.victim_killed_squadmate_within_s: The victim killed a squadmate of yours within this many seconds.
kill_flags.victim_spree_min: The victim had at least this many kills in their current life.
